name: Ambulance
summary: Ink sketch white ambulance with a red stripe, blue medical cross and flashing roof beacon, side view; for emergencies.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 690 px wide and 420 px tall at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: body colour (white by default); the stripe and cross are fixed red

params.name: anim
params.note: siren = the roof beacon flashes; wheels still roll when vx is not 0

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the vehicle faces left

author: krakujs
